meta.title: HARVI-ECG
meta.tagline: Heart-failure readouts from a standard 10-second 12-lead ECG
meta.affiliation: Medical University of Vienna, Center for Medical Physics and Biomedical Engineering
meta.note: AUROC with 95 % patient-bootstrap CI (2,000 draws). All values aggregate.

cohorts.name: EchoNext
cohorts.role: external test (NT-proBNP readout, zero-shot) + site adaptation (SHD module)

mimic_unexposed.endpoint: Mean rule-out + rule-in, patients never in pretraining

rule_out_decision.note: Positive class = measured NT-proBNP < 300 pg/mL. Sensitivity = share of patients < 300 that are ruled out; specificity = share of patients ≥ 300 that are not ruled out. Do not label any value as NPV.

density.count_layout: counts[y_bin][x_bin]  (x = measured, y = estimated, as in Figure 2C)
density.note: Values clipped at 10 pg/mL. Cells with fewer than 11 ECGs are set to 0 (aggregate-only release).

foundation_vs_baseline.baseline: Task-specific baseline: CNN-xLSTM trained from scratch on the same MIMIC-IV folds

shd_module.note: SHD module adapted on EchoNext echo labels (26,218 training patients, mean of 3 seeds) and evaluated on held-out EchoNext patients; never zero-shot. ᵃModerate or greater echo finding. †Post hoc endpoint.

labels_needed.note: Lightweight adaptation of the encoder (linear probe) on random subsets of EchoNext training patients, 5 draws per size; dashed reference = NT-proBNP readout with zero local labels.

benchmark_note: Published values as reported by the cited studies, on different cohorts; axis starts at 0.6.

architecture.detail: 10 s · 500 Hz · each lead normalised by the model
bidirectional xLSTM, lead-mixing tokenizer, 1,024-d embedding; self-supervised (SimDINO) on 6,009,279 ECGs
the only encoder parameters trained per task
uses age and sex; NT-proBNP estimate + rule-out, age-adjusted rule-in, severe
ECG only; one output per echo endpoint, adapted on a site's echo-labelled patients

limitations: Retrospective evaluation; prospective validation of the screening pathway is planned.
Emory phenotypes are ICD-10 coded. EchoNext records echo findings but not symptoms, so its positives include symptomatic heart failure and asymptomatic structural disease (Stage B).
The fixed 300 pg/mL rule-out cut-off needs recalibration at a new site; the age-adjusted rule-in cut-offs transferred to Emory without it.

operating_points.threshold_method: Youden threshold from the other 4 folds, applied to the held-out fold
